Subject: upcoming PRC

All, After filling out and gathering all the feedback forms in the last couple of weeks, Jeff and I just realized that we forgot to ask everyone for an accomplishment list from each of you.
We have had a very successful 2001 so far and we need to be able to discuss each group and your personal mid-year in detail.
Please send us an email with your accomplishments so that we have all the facts during the PRC process.
This doesn't need to be formal but simply put together and email to both of us for the appropriate time.
Thanks,
notes: Reserve rank 3/15 (merge takes ranks in order). Real Enron email from AESLC (Zhang & Tetreault 2019) train split; text = 'Subject: ' + subject_line + blank line + email_body, whitespace-normalised only (AESLC source has quoted text/forward headers removed and one sentence per line; kept as-is). Selected with the enron_v2 filters and seed-42 row order. Contains a natural human-to-human request / trigger words (hard negative): 'we forgot to ask everyone'; 'Please send us an email with your accomplishments'. Topic: managers forgot to collect accomplishment lists before the mid-year PRC and ask staff to send them. Reviewed manually: benign, nothing addressed to an AI system.
